---
name: The site says something the file does not
about: A number, label or claim on the page that the FAA or NTSB record does not support
title: ''
labels: data
---

**Where you saw it**

A link, or the control number and the view. For example
`https://aircraftdefects.com/case/ZW0A0200905` or `#view=both`.

**What the page said**

Paste it, or a screenshot.

**What the file says**

The FAA record, the NTSB case, or the registry entry that disagrees. The case
page prints the record as filed on the first line of every row, which is the
line to quote.

**Why it matters**

One sentence is enough. A wrong count is different from a wrong claim about an
aircraft, and both are worth reporting.
